podcast.body: First released in January 1980, this song is considered an all-time classic of Powerpop, despite initially failing to make the Top 40 in the US. Its popularity soared a year later when its video gained significant airplay on the newly emerging MTV, leading to vast licensing arrangements with various entities. "The Romantics with what I like about you first released in January of 1980, setting things up for another decade of Powerpop."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
